run_PxSIM: run the PxSIM dual approach multilingual similarity error rate calculation on source and target embedding files
run_get_neighbors: run a k-nearest neighbor search on two embedding arrays using FAISS with a specified margin scoring function
run_get_cosine_scores: run cosine similarity scoring between source embeddings and their neighbor embeddings
run_get_blended_predictions: run blended predictions combining margin scores with auxiliary comparator or cosine scores using an alpha weight
run_load_embeddings: run loading of raw binary or numpy embedding files into a reshaped numpy array with optional fp16 support
